text:
riley_sales: Heads-up: MedAssist verbal ok on a two-year reserved plan but they have strict PHI constraints and a hard monthly spend cap. They want guidance on reserved GPUs vs a "burst bank" model and whether preheat windows can be guaranteed in contract.
emma_infra: Congrats. Need traffic profile: p95/p99 latency targets, QPS shape (business hrs vs off), percent embeddings vs chat, and any synchronous SLAs. Also confirm single-region requirement.
riley_sales: They require single-region for now. Peak: 420 rps at 09:30-10:15, baseline 60 rps. Mix: 55% chat (median 140 tokens, 95p 900, 99p 1700), 45% embeddings (batched, ~24 texts). SLO: 95p < 1000ms, 99p < 1800ms.
tom_ml: With that 99p and long 99p tokens we should separate chat and embed pathways. For chat: prefer reserved, quantized fallback only if med-quality acceptable. For embeddings: batch workers on cheaper instances.
juan_sre: For contractual guarantees: we can offer reserved per-AZ pools plus a burst-credit bucket. Preheat windows are operationally feasible if scheduled in the contractwe'd add a runbook and health probes. However guaranteeing zero cold-start risk is tough; we can SLA max cold-start latency for preheated nodes.
nina_security: Because PHI is in-scope, Dedicated or Private required. We must enforce strict VPC peering, no shared logging into public buckets, and BYOK for KMS. Also need to confirm retention policy for logs and the ability to redact transcripts on demand. That affects feasibility of hosted bursts.cal_finance: Pricing note: customer target blended unit cost needs a 35% reduction vs our hosted list for the expected monthly token volume. Typical approach: structure a baseline reserved commit sized for 70% of peak and a pre-funded burst bank at discounted rate. Need a model of cost vs reserved count to trade off.
tom_ml: Quick back-of-envelope: using our 70B Llama variant perf profile, to meet 420rps 99p <1.8s we estimate 3-4 A100-equivalent reserved devices for chat plus 1-2 extra for burst/prewarm. With int8 safe fallback we could go to 2-3 reserved. Embedding fleet on 2 x T4-equivalents.
emma_infra: Operationally prefer reserved baseline per-AZ (spread across 3 AZs) so an AZ outage doesn't kill SLA. Autoscale policy: scale when per-device GPU queue >60% for >30s, cooldown 120s. Max burst cap = +60% for up to 20 minutes.
juan_sre: Add model-fallback policy: if request queue growth > 150ms for 45s, route ~30% of low-priority traffic to quantized variant for 10m windows, then reassess. Also add a rate-limiter at ingress to enforce contractual tail protections.
riley_sales: Customer asked: can we prepay burst credits monthly and top-up automatically? Also they want minute-level metering rather than per-token for burst to smooth billing variance.
cal_finance: We can support a pre-funded burst bank with per-minute burn accounting. We'll need a deflation schedule for unused burst at month end. Can model three options: smaller baseline + large burst bank, medium baseline + medium burst bank, or large baseline minimal burst. Each has different blended unit costs.
nina_security: Note: prewarmed instances still need to run inside their VPC for PHI. That implies Dedicated/Private reserved devices. Hosted bursts that leave VPC are not acceptable.
emma_infra: That increases ops surface. For preheat we will schedule instance warm-up 20 minutes prior to daily peak and keep a minimal hot pool at all times. We can script KV cache seeding with a reproducible corpus. Will add readiness probes that must pass before we flip traffic.
tom_ml: We'll prepare a short A/B quality checklist: check top-10 prompts for regressions when falling back to int8. Integrate into Redwood Optimize to surface regression alerts.
juan_sre: Action items: emma/juan will produce an autoscale + preheat runbook; tom will run perf sims for the three billing scenarios; cal will produce cost model spreadsheet; nina will start security checklist; riley will collect real payload samples and SOC2 artifacts.
deploy-bot: Load-sim queued: job-id ls-2026-5251. Results will post to https://internal.redwood/ls/ls-2026-5251 in ~48h.
riley_sales: I'll get samples and customer SOC2 pack today. Do we have ETA on sims?
tom_ml: 72 hours after samples to run sims and produce a capacity vs cost matrix with 95/99 estimates.
emma_infra: We'll draft contract language for preheat windows and burst bank SLAs; expect draft in 5 business days.
cal_finance: I'll include three commercial scenarios in the spreadsheet with blended per-token and per-minute burst options and suggested minimum monthly commit.
nina_security: Also requesting customer's list of data processors and retention rules; that will determine whether Private is mandatory.
riley_sales: Thanks all. Let's sync in 48h after deploy-bot posts the first sim. :white_check_mark:
